messages:
Emma: FYI escalating — BlueOak reporting repeated 503s from hosted inference over last 45m. Customer sees spikes during batch runs, SDK retries making it worse. They say requests succeed intermittently, then flip to streaming resets.
Oliver: thanks, emma. severity? customer says frontend users hit failures, some billing duplicates due to retry loop. Marking P2->P1 if we see system impact.
Emma: attaching sample request and truncated logs below from their SDK (node). they repro w/ concurrent 40 streams, each stream ~8k tokens.
Emma: ````
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
Connection: keep-alive
Body: {"model":"rwd-large","prompt":"<...>","max_tokens":1024,"stream":true}
````
Emma: customer logs show a repeating pattern: 200s then a handful of 503s and then TCP resets. snippet: ````
[2026-03-15T09:12:01Z] conn=178 request_id=abc123 status=200 latency_ms=110
[2026-03-15T09:12:03Z] conn=178 request_id=abc124 status=503 backend=serve-22 keepalive_closed=true
[2026-03-15T09:12:03Z] conn=178 error=tcp_reset
[2026-03-15T09:12:05Z] conn=180 request_id=abc125 status=200
````
Raj: interesting — keepalive_closed=true flagged by their edge. which LB are they using? Emma: they use our hosted EU cluster (eu-west-1) via our public API, no customer-managed LB.
Maya: can we get internal ingress logs for those req_ids? might be proxy upstream hitting idle timeout and closing long-lived streams. streaming with keep-alive and our proxy idle timeout mismatch could cause a RST if the client reuses a conn after it's closed.
Liu: oncall here — adding trace collection. emma can you ask BlueOak for a pcap or curl reproduction? also their node SDK version?
Emma: they tried node SDK v1.3.2 and raw curl. repro works with both, but easier to hit with SDK batch loop. curl example they used: ````
curl -v -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-large","prompt":"x","max_tokens":1024,"stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
````
Emma: they said toggling HTTP/2 -> HTTP/1.1 (via curl --http1.1) changed behavior — HTTP/2 sessions were more resilient.
Raj: that matches a keepalive vs HTTP/2 multiplexing theory. with HTTP/1.1 our edge uses connection pooling and may close idle sockets earlier. need to check edge idle timeout (currently 30s).
Maya: runtime note — long streaming responses keep the connection alive for many seconds (sometimes minutes for 8k tokens). if our idle timeout resets during intermittent network flakiness, client retries can re-open new connections causing backend to see a rapid surge (backpressure) and return 5xx when queues fill.
Oliver: priority then: (1) reproduce internally, (2) quick mitigation for customer, (3) root cause.
Liu: repro plan: run 40 concurrent curl streams with random small pauses (to mimic unstable mobile network) against eu-west cluster, vary --http1.1 vs http2. collecting ingress metrics + edge logs. assigning to Raj + Maya.
Raj: I'll spin up the repro and attach ingress logs. initial guess: edge idle timeout (30s) too low for long streams, causing keepalive close and RST. quick fix: bump idle to 120s for eu-west ingress and enable connection: keep-alive hints for streaming endpoints. need SRE approval.
Maya: runtime can add a server-side guard: if connection closed while compute still producing, mark as transient and attempt write to fallback socket? that's complex. short-term we can enable a model-level rate cap / per-conn queue throttle to reduce backend queueing under reconnect storms.
Emma: customer asked for ETA on workaround — what's safe to offer?
Raj: if SRE approves, we can patch edge config in eu-west within 1-2 hours to increase idle timeout. I'll request change now.
deploy-bot: [deploy request] patch/edge-config/eu-west/increase-idle-timeout -> REQUESTED by Raj at 2026-03-15T09:20:45Z
Liu: monitoring note: I'll put alert on connection_reset_rate and backend_queue_len and watch for drop in 5xx after the config change.
Oliver: communications: Emma please tell BlueOak: "We've identified edge idle timeouts interacting with long streaming requests. We're rolling a configuration change to increase the keep-alive/idle timeout in eu-west to reduce premature socket closes; this should lower 503s within ~1-2 hours. We'll follow up with logs and ask you to test. If you need immediate relief, switch SDK to prefer HTTP/2 or reduce per-client concurrency as a workaround." include a suggested curl command with --http2.
Emma: sent update to customer (copied): "Thanks — we are rolling an infra tweak now and will follow up with repro logs. If you can try with HTTP/2 in the meantime (--http2), that helps. We'll confirm in ~30–90m."
Maya: after we confirm reduction in 503 we should write a runbook entry: "streaming long responses + keepalive mismatch" and add recommended defaults for SDK (prefer http2, recommended concurrency per client).
Raj: update: SRE approved config change. applying now.
deploy-bot: [deploy status] patch/edge-config/eu-west/increase-idle-timeout -> IN_PROGRESS
Liu: infra metrics show a drop in connection_reset_rate starting T+6m. I'll keep monitoring for 30m window.
Emma: customer replied: "we see far fewer errors, thanks — we'll test heavy batch tomorrow morning." :thumbsup:
Oliver: great. please keep thread open until we've followed up with final RCA and runbook. assign to Maya for RCA writeup and Raj for infra changelog.
Maya: will draft RCA: root cause — idle socket close at edge (30s) + high-concurrency reconnects causing backend queue saturation -> 503s. mitigations: increased idle to 120s (eu-west), recommend SDK HTTP/2, add per-conn rate limits, and runbook.
Raj: adding change to infra changelog and scheduling a postmortem doc with eng-infra to decide permanent idle policy.
Emma: closing customer-facing loop later today. keeping thread open for RCA.
